title: Change Customer is disabled on a closed internal work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Hover over "Change Customer" on the customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens, Closed.

Step 2:

  • "Change Customer" is disabled with the tooltip "Reopen the work order to change the customer."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R9: “From Close or invoice on, the classification and the category are locked: a closed no-charge work order shows the No Charge badge with no Convert or Change category action, on a closed internal or no-charge work order the Change Customer button on the customer card is disabled with the tooltip "Reopen the work order to change the customer." (the lock an invoiced or paid billable work order has today, S2-R7), and the header card carries the line "Closed on [posting date]. To change it, reopen it from the Finance tab." There is no Reopen control on the work order itself (Story 4).”
  • S2-R7: “Changing the customer on a work order works as today (not offered on an invoiced or paid billable work order, as today, nor on a closed internal or no-charge work order, S2-R9); until then the classification follows the new customer: to an internal customer the work order becomes internal (prices removed, costs and hours kept, no Convert actions); to a regular customer from an internal one it becomes billable (lines priced as in S2-R6). A No Charge mark and its category survive a change to another regular customer; a no-charge work order moved to an internal customer becomes internal and loses its category. The Change Customer dialog says what will happen to the prices and, when the work order stays internal or no charge, adds "Shop supplies resets to [customer]'s minimum ($[amount])." (without 'See Financial Data' the sentence omits the amount).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
